AMENDED TO BE A TYPE 1 #22938 -TL
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
6743 South Honore Street
From RS-3 to RT-4

The Property
The subject property is a vacant parcel located in a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District and
improved with a two story residential building with two dwelling units. The first floor unit is legal.

The Project
Rosa Rodiles (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property to legalize the second floor dwelling unit for a total

of two units on the property, to legalize an as-built rear two story addition and an as-built 2nd story addition to
the existing two flat building. Two surface parking spaces will be provided at the rear of the property.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District to
RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, through a Type-1
application under section 17-13-0300(D) as follows: 1) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to
reduce the required front setback pursuant to section 17-2-0305 including section 17-2-0305-B from 18.38 feet to
15.25 feet; 2) an optional variation under section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the north side setback required pursuant
to section 17-2-0309-A from 2.0 feet to 0.89 feet (the south side setback at 2.6’); 3) an optional variation under
section 17-13-1101-B to reduce the total combined side setback pursuant to section 17-2-0309-A from 5.0 feet to
3.49 feet.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 3,116.28 square feet

Maximum FAR: 0.88

Floor Area: 2,712.22 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 2 existing

MLA Density: 1,558.14 square feet

Height: 227-10” existing

Automobile Parking: 2

Setbacks (existing): Front (West/Honore): 15.25 feet* (existing)
North: 0.89 feet* (existing)
South: 2.6 feet* (existing)
Rear (East): 46.26 feet

A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
